_about: Sea step 5d hull (core/sea/hull_rules.gd, game/sea_hull.gd). hull = max hull points per ship. A single hit of at least open_share of the max opens / widens the hole at the nearest of the 3 leak zones by hole_per_share per share (cap 1). Holds flood at flood_per_second per full hole, pumps drain drain_per_second when no hole is open. Water slows (slow_at_full_water) and sinks the ship lower (sit_lower x draft); sink_water or hull 0 = sunk. Aground faster than aground_from m/s: aground_damage x (speed - from)^2. A plank (any of planks) takes patch_seconds at a leak zone within patch_reach m: closes it + patch_hull of max; with no holes mend_hull of max. Sunk: goes down over sink_seconds, comes back at the shipyard with refloat_hull of max, needs seaworthy of max to weigh anchor. ALL NUMBERS ARE PLACEHOLDERS.
